description: Write a retained revision back as the current document. The retained row is copied through the normal write path, with a reason. Nothing is deleted.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

reason.description: Why this revision is restored. At least 10 characters.

session_id.description: Transcript session id. Required on Path 2.

source.description: Source tag. Must be in EMET_RESTORE_TAGS. A missing source is refused.

version.description: Retained revision number to write back.

name: restore_doc
